name: 94588 · Pleasanton, CA
findings: ZIP 94588 (Pleasanton) has 190 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94588 (Pleasanton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94588 (Pleasanton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
